Kit summary

Fluid Double StrikeBasic
Deals 2 stages of DMG to a single enemy, the first stage of which deals 120% ATK DMG, with a 40% chance to inflict [Stun] for 1 turn, and the second stage of which deals 220% ATK DMG and has 30% extra Crit DMG.
Perfect StrikeActiveExclusive Lv.1
Deals 200% ATK DMG to all enemies, and deals extra DMG by 5% of the target's Max HP (up to 15% of self Max HP).
Fluid Sword Lv.1If Graceful Multi-Strike triggers at least 4 Crits, Donald Rebeli additionally casts Perfect Strike 1 time after Graceful Multi-Strike is cast.
Aristocratic DuelPassiveExclusive Lv.2 · Lv.3
At the beginning of each wave, inflicts [Duel] on the enemy with the highest ATK, under which effect the enemy can only target Donald Rebeli when attacking. Meanwhile, increases self DMG dealt to the target under [Duel] status by 30% and reduces their DMG dealt to self by 50%. At the beginning of each turn, inflicts [Duel] on a new target if no enemy is under [Duel] status.
Fluid Sword Lv.2Donald Rebeli restores to his Max HP Cap immediately after taking Fatal DMG for the first time at each wave. Afterward, Donald Rebeli acts for 1 turn immediately and enters [Combat] with the target under [Duel] status. Both sides under [Combat] status are forced to attack each other with basic attacks during their turns. Only when one of them dies will [Combat] end. If either of them cannot enter [Combat], neither of them will enter [Combat]. Instead, Donald Rebeli refreshes the CD of all his skills and acts for 1 turn immediately. [Combat] status is considered as control effects and [Provoke].
Fluid Sword Lv.3Inflicts [Shackle] on the same target for 1 turn each time [Duel] is inflicted. The target under [Shackle] status cannot release their active skills, and they will lose 15% of Max HP (caps at 45% of Donald Rebeli's Max HP) when [Shackle]'s duration ends. Targets on whom [Shackle] cannot be inflicted will lose HP directly instead. [Shackle] is considered as [Silence].
Graceful Multi-StrikeActiveExclusive Lv.1
Deals 5 stages of 260% ATK DMG each to a single enemy. The first stage has an additional 30% Crit DMG. Each subsequent stage has an additional 20% Crit DMG than the previous stage.
Fluid Sword Lv.1If Graceful Multi-Strike triggers at least 4 Crits, Donald Rebeli additionally casts Perfect Strike 1 time after Graceful Multi-Strike is cast.
